STRONGER
THAN EVER.
The legend of Chevy Silverado takes
another step forward.
First, we partnered with American
Expedition Vehicles (AEV) to take
the already formidable ZR2 and elevate
it into the ultimate off-road beast
with the Bison Edition. Next, we took a
powerful engine lineup and enhanced the
available Duramax® 3.0L Turbo-Diesel
engine with even more horsepower
and torque.
Add to that available advanced trailering
technologies, a standard Durabed and
the hardworking capability of Silverado
and you have the strength to handle
whatever comes next.
